title: Curable.Blockchain DAO (Series 17) — Blue Lagoon Cell
summary: An agent-managed, human-governed DAO cell built among the steaming silica lagoons and black lava of Reykjanes. Agents synthesize and route; stewards vote. Five zones from Charter Hall to Progress Observatory.

buildings.name: Charter Pavilion
buildings.use: Charter display, contribution model, measurable outcomes ledger

buildings.name: Stewards' Longhouse
buildings.use: Human-only voting chamber for reserved governance actions

districts.real_anchor: The Retreat at Blue Lagoon Iceland

buildings.name: Evidence Archive
buildings.use: Storage and indexing of monitored developments

buildings.name: Proposal Forum Hall
buildings.use: Agent-drafted proposals debated and decided by people

buildings.name: Draft Review Annex
buildings.use: Grant and proposal drafting workspace for human review

buildings.name: Collaborator Outpost
buildings.use: Scouting hub for experts and collaborators

court.name: The Steam Court of Bláa lónið
court.style: Open-air lava amphitheater ringed by geothermal steam vents
court.why_here: Set beside the milky silica lagoon, where rising steam naturally marks the gathering point for human stewards to cast reserved votes.

quests.title: Charter Stewards' Orientation
steps: Read the charter stone and list the six human-reserved actions
Record a contribution pledge at the Contribution Desk
Trace one measurable outcome to the Progress Observatory tracker
Confirm no agent holds final-vote authority

quests.title: From Evidence to Draft
steps: Collect three monitored developments from the Evidence Monitor
Have the Research Synthesis Agent summarize them for stewards
Deliver the summary to the Proposal & Grant Drafter
Post the draft for human review — never enact it

quests.title: Route the Working Groups
steps: Pick up routed tasks from the Task Router console
Register one collaborator found by the Collaborator Scout
Assign the collaborator to the Research Synthesis Lab evidence sweep
Report completion between decision cycles

quests.title: The Steam Court Quorum
steps: Carry a debated proposal to the Steam Court
Ring the quorum bell to summon human stewards
Witness the final vote — agents abstain
Record the outcome in the Charter Hall ledger

quests.title: Outcome Audit on the Lagoon Trail
steps: Audit two milestones at the Progress Observatory
Flag a stalled outcome to the Task Router
Open a corrective working group on the Operations Deck
Post the revised plan for the next human decision cycle
